# 🚦 LLM Gateways & Routers Directory

![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.1.0-blue) ![tools](https://img.shields.io/badge/tools-8-green) ![open%20source](https://img.shields.io/badge/open%20source-5-brightgreen) ![categories](https://img.shields.io/badge/categories-2-purple) [![CI](https://github.com/Amarel-Taylor-Scott/llm-gateways-routers-directory/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Amarel-Taylor-Scott/llm-gateways-routers-directory/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

> A curated, machine-readable directory of **LLM gateways, proxies & routers** — the layer that gives your app one unified API with routing, fallbacks, retries, caching, rate-limiting, and cost control across many model providers.

Distinct from the inference engines that *serve* models and from raw provider endpoints: these *route and manage* calls across providers. Ships a small CLI to search/filter/export. Nothing is vendored here.

## Quick start

```bash
pip install -e .                 # stdlib-only; no runtime deps
gateway-dir list                 # list all
gateway-dir list --open-source   # only OSS gateways
gateway-dir search router        # search name/org/note/tags
gateway-dir export --format csv > gateways.csv
gateway-dir generate             # regenerate this README
```

## At a glance

- **8** tools across **2** categories
- 🟢 **5** open source · 🔒 **3** proprietary / hosted

## Directory

### Managed Gateways & Routers (3)

| Tool | Org | Source | License | Notes |
|------|-----|--------|---------|-------|
| [Cloudflare AI Gateway](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/) | Cloudflare | 🔒 Proprietary | Proprietary | Managed gateway: caching, rate-limiting, and analytics for LLM API calls. |
| [Eden AI](https://www.edenai.co) | Eden AI | 🔒 Proprietary | Proprietary | Single API aggregating many AI/LLM providers and tasks. |
| [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai) | OpenRouter | 🔒 Proprietary | Proprietary | Unified API that routes across many LLMs/providers with a single key. |

### Open-Source Gateways & Routers (5)

| Tool | Org | Source | License | Notes |
|------|-----|--------|---------|-------|
| [Kong AI Gateway](https://github.com/Kong/kong) | Kong | 🟢 OSS | Apache-2.0 | AI Gateway plugins on Kong for routing, auth, and rate-limiting LLM traffic. |
| [LiteLLM](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm) | BerriAI | 🟢 OSS | MIT | Proxy + Python SDK to call 100+ LLM APIs via one OpenAI-compatible interface. |
| [One API](https://github.com/songquanpeng/one-api) | songquanpeng | 🟢 OSS | MIT | Self-hosted, OpenAI-compatible gateway/distributor for many model providers. |
| [Portkey AI Gateway](https://github.com/Portkey-AI/gateway) | Portkey | 🟢 OSS | MIT | Fast open-source AI gateway: routing, fallbacks, retries across providers. |
| [RouteLLM](https://github.com/lm-sys/RouteLLM) | LMSYS | 🟢 OSS | Apache-2.0 | Framework to route between strong/weak models to cut cost. |

## Choosing one (rules of thumb)

- **Self-host an OpenAI-compatible proxy:** LiteLLM, One API, Portkey Gateway.
- **Route to cut cost:** RouteLLM.
- **Don't run infra (hosted):** OpenRouter, Eden AI, Cloudflare AI Gateway.
- **Already on an API gateway:** Kong AI Gateway.
